title: State Rep. Danny McCormick addresses assassination of Charlie Kirk and calls for abortion policy changes - Shreveport Reporter
text:
State Representative Danny McCormick, a member of the Louisiana House of Representatives and the Louisiana Freedom Caucus, addressed several issues in recent posts on his official X account.
On September 15, 2025, McCormick commented on the death of Charlie Kirk, stating: “These words ring truer than ever as we grieve the horrific assassination of Charlie Kirk, a devoted husband, father of two young children, and tireless patriot who gave his life to the good of our nation. Charlie was gunned down in cold blood right in front of his family,”.
The following day, September 16, 2025, McCormick addressed federal abortion policy. He wrote: “Taxpayer-funded abortion tourism must end. The Louisiana Freedom Caucus is officially calling on Speaker Johnson and Congress to do the right thing: end the illegal policy that uses federal dollars to subsidize travel for out-of-state abortions. This failed subsidy regime”.
A subsequent post made later that same day contained only a link: “https://t.co/kjzPBjlAyF”.
McCormick’s comments regarding abortion funding reflect ongoing debates about federal policies related to reproductive health services and state efforts to restrict or regulate access. The Louisiana Freedom Caucus has been active in voicing opposition to federal funding mechanisms they argue facilitate out-of-state abortions.
Charlie Kirk was a well-known conservative activist and founder of Turning Point USA. His work centered around promoting conservative values among young Americans.
